name: Mexican Spiced Salmon with Walnut Guacamole & Bell Pepper-Corn Sauté

instructions.primary_message: Preheat oven to broil on high and position rack under the broiler.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
6 red bell peppers
1 small bunch cilantro
3 limes
3 avocados

instructions.primary_message: Trim, seed, and small dice bell peppers; place in a large bowl.
Shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add to the bowl with the bell pepper and set aside.
Pat fish dry with paper towels and transfer to a large baking sheet pan. Drizzle both sides with oil, arrange skin-side down, then season top side with spices.
instructions.secondary_message:
1.02 kg salmon fillet
2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
1 ½ tsp chili powder
1 ½ tsp oregano, dried
1 ½ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper
¾ tsp cumin, ground

instructions.primary_message: Place baking sheet in the oven and broil until salmon is just opaque, about 5 minutes. Flip salmon and continue to broil until the skin is crispy, 3-4 minutes more. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, preheat a large skillet over medium heat.

Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add bell pepper, cilantro, corn, salt, and pepper; cook, stirring occasionally, until veggies are tender, 6-7 minutes. Remove from heat. (Reserve bowl for the next step.)
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
3 cups frozen corn
1 ½ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: While the veggies are cooking, peel and mince shallots and garlic. Place both in the reserved bowl.
Juice half of the limes into the bowl with the shallot and garlic. (Cut remaining limes into wedges and set aside for serving.)
Halve and pit avocados; using a spoon, scoop the flesh into the bowl. Add spices and mash with a fork or potato masher until guacamole is smooth.
instructions.secondary_message:
½ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper
¼ tsp chili powder

instructions.primary_message: Roughly chop walnuts, add to the bowl with the guacamole, and stir to combine.
Divide salmon and veggies between plates; top salmon with guacamole and serve with lime wedges for squeezing. Enjoy!
